analysis.headline: Shares Your Info with Affiliates
analysis.quote: Any of the your personal information that we collect may be transferred (or otherwise made available) to our affiliates and other third parties who provide website and administrative/operational support services on our behalf.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Collect Your Data
analysis.quote: Personal information may be collected by such providers for their own use, in line with their own privacy practices.

analysis.headline: Third-Party Analytics Tracking
analysis.quote: We and our third-party service providers, including Google Analytics, process, store and analyze information obtained from your browser when you visit our website, including IP addresses, device identifiers, browser characteristics, operating system details, language preferences, referring URLs, length of visits, and pages viewed.

analysis.headline: Third-Party Cookies for Ads
analysis.quote: Cookies may also used on our website by third parties for analytics, specifically, by Google Analytics, Twitter, Reddit, Paypal, and Bitcoin.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Legally
analysis.quote: DuckDNS may share personal information with our affiliates, and with companies, organizations or individuals outside of DuckDNS if we have a good-faith belief that access, use, preservation or disclosure of the information is reasonably necessary or desirable to: meet any applicable law, regulation, legal process or enforceable governmental request.

analysis.headline: Sells Your Info in Mergers
analysis.quote: Personal information may be provided to third parties in connection with a merger or sale (including transfers made as part of insolvency or bankruptcy proceedings) involving all or part of DuckDNS or as part of a reorganization or stock sale or other change in control, including for the purpose of determining whether to proceed or continue with such transaction or business relationship.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: Your personal information may be maintained and processed by us, our affiliates and other third-party service providers in the US or other jurisdictions.

analysis.headline: Ignores Do Not Track
analysis.quote: Like many websites, this website is not designed to respond to "Do Not Track" signals received from browsers.

analysis.headline: Keeps Your Data One Year
analysis.quote: We store the data we collect for about a year after a user and the DNS entry is no longer active.
